cardOverview.overviewText: A Crest card positioned as an ultra-premium product, providing unlimited lounge access, concierge support, luxury experiences, and milestone rewards.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: B1G1 free offer on up to 3 movie tickets monthly on BookMyShow, with a maximum discount of ₹700 per ticket.|Any amount exceeding ₹700 per ticket is payable with the card.|Additionally, receive an extra ₹50 discount on selecting the Food & Beverage option. Enjoy a 20% discount on theatre and event bookings on BookMyShow, with a maximum discount of ₹700.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: CLUB ITC
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your Club ITC Culinaire membership with the IndusInd Crest Credit Card, you’ll be automatically enrolled once your card is activated. You’ll receive your membership kit within 30 working days. For your spouse, you can contact customer care for enrollment. Once enrolled, you’ll enjoy benefits like discounts on dining, exclusive stay offers, and bonus Green Points during special occasions like birthdays. Simply present your membership details when booking or dining at participating ITC Hotels. The membership is valid for 12 months, and both you and your spouse will have the same expiry date.
